content.user_title: Integrate Better Auth with Next.js App Router
content.value_statement: Next.js App Router authentication requires coordinated middleware, sessions, providers, and secure token handling. This skill guides Better Auth setup patterns from configuration through protected routes.
actual_capabilities: Outlines Better Auth initialization with providers, adapters, callbacks, and frontend client setup.
Explains JWT token generation, validation, expiration, refresh, payload claims, and signing choices.
Guides App Router session context setup across root layouts, server components, and client components.
Describes protected route middleware, server-side checks, unauthorized redirects, and route access states.
Covers authentication testing, error handling, security considerations, and performance tradeoffs.
limitations: Provides conceptual implementation guidance, not a complete generated application.
Assumes Next.js 13 or newer with the App Router architecture.
Does not target Pages Router applications or custom authentication systems outside Better Auth.
Requires the user to supply project-specific database, provider, and secret management details.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Auth Setup
use_cases.description: Define Better Auth architecture before building sign-in, sessions, and protected routes in a new App Router project.

use_cases.title: Add Route Protection
use_cases.description: Map middleware, server checks, and redirects for pages that require authenticated user sessions.

use_cases.title: Review Auth Reliability
use_cases.description: Check token handling, session persistence, error states, and test coverage before release.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Basic Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan Better Auth integration for a Next.js App Router app. Ask for my providers, database adapter, and protected routes before suggesting steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design Session Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design the session flow for my App Router project. Include server component access, client hook usage, persistence, refresh behavior, and logout handling.

prompt_templates.title: Protect Application Routes
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an implementation plan for protected routes using Better Auth and Next.js middleware. Include redirects, unauthorized states, and server-side checks.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Auth Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Better Auth architecture for session security, JWT handling, CSRF protection, middleware coverage, and authentication edge cases. Identify gaps and fixes.

output_examples.input: I need Better Auth in a new App Router application.
output_examples.output: A setup plan covering provider configuration, session context placement, server access patterns, protected routes, and required environment secrets.

output_examples.input: My dashboard should require sign-in before rendering.
output_examples.output: A route protection approach with middleware checks, authenticated responses, unauthenticated redirects, and consistent session state for server and client components.

output_examples.input: I want to verify my authentication release checklist.
output: Confirm secure cookies and secret storage.
Test session expiration, refresh, and logout.
Validate protected route behavior for authenticated and unauthenticated users.

best_practices: Define providers, database adapters, callbacks, and secrets before wiring client components.
Keep sensitive session checks on the server when protected content depends on authentication.
Test sign-in, sign-up, logout, expiration, redirects, and provider failures before release.
anti_patterns: Storing authentication secrets or tokens in client-side code.
Protecting sensitive routes only with client-side redirects.
Adding social providers without validating callback URLs and error handling.

faq.question: Does this skill generate a complete Better Auth project?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation guidance and review prompts for integrating Better Auth into an existing Next.js project.

faq.question: Does it support the Next.js Pages Router?
faq.answer: No. The skill is written for App Router projects and does not cover Pages Router patterns.

faq.question: Can it help with protected routes?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers middleware, server-side checks, redirects, and authenticated route behavior.

faq.question: Can it help with JWT configuration?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes token generation, validation, expiration, refresh, payload claims, and signing choices.

faq.question: Does it handle social login planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes social authentication provider integration as part of the authentication flow guidance.

faq.question: What project details should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide your Next.js structure, providers, database adapter, protected routes, callback URLs, and secret management approach.
